### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

> _Example: "I am always frustrated when navigating through large IPTV channel lists because there is no quick-jump letter index on Android TV..."_

### Target Platform(s)

_(Which platforms should this feature apply to? Check all that apply)_

- [ ] **Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV**
- [ ] **Android Mobile / Tablet**
- [ ] **StreamNet TV Web (iOS / iPadOS / Desktop Browser)**

---

### Feature Category

_(Check the primary area this feature affects)_

- [ ] **Player & Playback** (ExoPlayer, gestures, PIP, audio passthrough, speed controls, codecs)
- [ ] **Subtitles & Audio** (AI subtitle tools, styling, sync adjustments, track selector)
- [ ] **IPTV / Live TV** (EPG guide improvements, channel management, Xtream / M3U)
- [ ] **Integrations & Sources** (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Telegram, Addons, Debrid)
- [ ] **Catalogs & Metadata** (TMDB, Trakt lists, MDBList, filter & sorting options)
- [ ] **Profiles & Cloud Sync** (Multi-user, Trakt scrobbling, profile PINs, cloud backup)
- [ ] **UI / UX & Customization** (Homescreen rows, themes, remote D-Pad navigation)

---

### Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision using it.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workflows, or third-party implementations you have considered.

### Mockups / UI References _(If applicable)_

Add any concept mockups, sketches, screenshots, or examples from other apps to illustrate the UI/UX.

---

### Compliance & Policy Check

- [ ] I confirm this request adheres to StreamNet TV's source policy (i.e., it does **not** request hosting copyrighted media, bundling pre-loaded pirated streams, or distributing illegal playlists).

### Additional Context

Add any other context, technical links (e.g. ExoPlayer documentation, API specs), or notes about the feature request here.
